purpose: Offline acceptance fixture for Switchback's browser-native tool surface.

acceptance.registration: Every active tool is offered to the browser model context.
acceptance.routing: validate_circuit dry-runs a directed loop and plan_route renders it before returning.
acceptance.agent_worklog: record_session_note leaves a visible, local-to-tab record of agent test and handoff work.
acceptance.limitations: Unsupported elevation and grade constraints must be rejected rather than estimated.
